content.description:
Market Domination Overtime host Josh Lipton takes a look at the top stories for investors to watch on Wednesday, Oct. 14.

Bank of America (BAC), Morgan Stanley (MS), United Airlines (UAL), Synchrony Financial (SYF), ASML (ASML), and Abbott Laboratories (ABT) all report earnings results.

Federal Reserve commentary is expected from Atlanta Fed President Raphael Bostic, Fed Governor Stephen Miran, and Fed Governor Christopher Waller.

The Fed Beige Book will release new economic data in the afternoon.

content.title: The Consumer Is Cracking. These 2 Airline Stocks Can Handle It, BofA Says.
content.summary: Americans are nervous about the economy, and that concern is weighing on consumer stocks.  While the stock market may be close to record highs, American consumers have plenty to be anxious about, including lingering inflation, tariffs, and the ongoing government shutdown—not to mention the possibility that artificial intelligence may be coming for their jobs.  The University of Michigan’s consumer sentiment index clocked in at 55.1 for the first two weeks of October, below the expectations of economists tracked by  FactSet  The reading wasn’t much better than it was in the summer of 2022 when inflation spiked, or the in early 2010s following the global financial crisis.

content.title: United Airlines Set For First Flight With Starlink. What Passengers Must Have To Use It.
content.summary: The Starlink satellite internet service will make history Wednesday, when United Airlines has scheduled its first mainline flight using Starlink in-flight Wi-Fi.  Meanwhile, United Airlines continues to add wireless connectivity to its regional fleet.  United flight 2940 is due to take off from Newark to Houston at 8 a.m. ET in a Boeing 737 with the first Starlink installed on any major airline on a mainline flight, the carrier said.
